scope: Every reached turn on all three pre-existing held source tapes; count candidate physical distribution once per ask, no sampling of branches. Parent is archived strict deterministic bc command. Opponent actual historical concurrent command shared by all physical branches, branch isolated official+cash ledger.

primary_domains.bank: own minus opponent ordinary warehouse deposits
primary_domains.cargo: own minus opponent alive opening cargo, team receipt or loss on collision reflected with opposite sign if the enemy dies
primary_domains.intercept: own minus opponent loot actually acquired in collision
primary_domains.trees: own minus opponent net new and captured tree count, captures change net control by two

warrant: With verified branch and replay contracts: at least two maps have a changed supported command with a nonzero economic domain consequence; one named domain must have favorable mean expected delta versus BC on at least two maps and positive equal-map mean. If all four domains averaged over maps are nonpositive, do not suggest spending on strength. Mixed side effects and geography recorded in every case. Descriptive one-step diagnostic; does not certify stronger, qualify ladder or spend formal maps.
unchanged: A sole command identical to source contributes zero on every outcome; replay through official terminal independently.
reported: all logged joint commands and their physical probabilities, immutable opponent command and official transition checks for every different support
one-step expected change arithmetic across commands, then mean per map; all turns denominator
risk, opportunity and actual income by source, including new losses, spent money, held cargo and unavailable counterfactual continuations
